opening.argument: The speaker urges viewers to join through a sponsor link, identifies 18 BUSD as needed, and ties participation to slots, team-building, and sponsorship. He says, “If your upline is in working, it is working it is purchasing slot, it is making team, it is sponsoring people, only then you will get money.” He also claims, “From past 13 months my total earning from this program, is 7 Crores,” while the supplied evidence does not independently corroborate that figure or establish transaction outcomes. His recollection that he once called the system a scam is presented as a rejected earlier view, not a warning against joining. The warning not to share wallet recovery words is separate from the enrollment and income pitch. Taken together, the recruitment, tiered activity, and claimed earnings support the position that this is a scam.

citations.quote: as soon as you join the system, you have to run the link of an individual who will sponsor you
you will need 18 BUSD in the system
If your upline is in working, it is working it is purchasing slot, it is making team, it is sponsoring people, only then you will get money.
From past 13 months my total earning from this program, is 7 Crores
And what did I say? This is a scam. It is a fraud.
